items.title: INV-063 P1 gate re-measured under V3-EXQ-798a's EXACT P0 and configuration: does the SD-MEL-PRODUCER intake ladder grade waking MEL at all? (monotone + registered relative spread > 0.25, per seed, >= 2/3 seeds)
items.note:
USER-COMMISSIONED, option (a) of chip-20260919-inv063-p1-gate-blocks-ladder (user answer 2026-09-19T23:48:33Z): 'RE-MEASURE P1 UNDER 798a's EXACT P0 FIRST, ALONE.' This is that one bounded measurement. It does NOT run INV-063's four-arm ladder, does NOT touch leg B or either frozen-battery readout, and routes NO verdict on the claim.

WHAT IT SETTLES. INV-063's P1 precondition requires mean waking MEL monotone across the four intake arms with relative spread > 0.25. The corpus disagrees with itself about whether that holds, and P1 gates the INDEPENDENT VARIABLE, so everything else in the falsifier is downstream of it. V3-EXQ-798a's landed runs met P1 on 2-3 of 3 seeds; this session's probes measured registered spread 0.152/0.212/0.118 and monotone 0/3. The probes used a CHEAPER P0 and -- found at authoring time -- a materially different configuration: alpha_world 0.3 vs 798a's 0.9 (the shipped default AND the documented SD-008 root cause for degraded z_world fidelity, in a run whose DV is a world-prediction quantity), dims 16 vs 32, grid 5x5 vs 12x12, no harm/goal/benefit streams, random-action P0 vs the E3 selection path. This run transcribes 798a's ENV_BASE, _make_agent, _step_cycle and _run_step_budget VERBATIM and ASSERTS the load-bearing config fields back off the LIVE agent, so a result is attributable to the configuration either way.

LOAD-BEARING OUTPUT, exactly what the user scoped and nothing else: C1_p1_met_per_seed, which is 798a:1015-1017 verbatim -- PER SEED, MEL non-decreasing across the intake-sorted arms (MONO_TOL=0.02 slack vs the floor arm) AND relative spread >= 0.25, where spread is the REGISTERED statistic (mel[HIGH]-mel[NONE])/mel[NONE] (701c:694) -- then >= 2/3 of seeds. The monotone and spread components are recorded as D1/D2 and route NOTHING. Readiness R2 (P0 converged), P4 (config equals 798a's), the weight-restore control and window population all GATE to substrate_not_ready_requeue. 798a's R1 is RECORDED but SCOPED OUT: it certifies the frozen-probe battery, which this run's DV never reads.

PRE-REGISTERED GO/NO-GO, committed in the driver before the run: GREEN -> INV-063's leg B runs on the SD-056 InfoNCE readout at a PINNED tau = 1e-3 (this session measured headroom below ln(K) at 23.88/21.61/23.45 percent per seed there, against 0.5-0.8 percent at the shipped tau=0.1 where V3-EXQ-1063's pre-registered readability condition failed by 9.66x; GFLAG-0367). The re-point is USER-RATIFIED 2026-09-19T21:42:30Z and PENDING governance application of GFLAG-0364 -- the same posture V3-EXQ-1039a used for its A2 narrowing. RED -> INV-063 converts to substrate_conditional via its own escape hatch.

COST, revised honestly upward. The user's decision budgeted ~3h on this session's earlier estimate, which was taken from 5x5/dim-16 probe timings. 798a's landed elapsed gives 0.931 s/step for THIS configuration, which puts the grid at ~7.1h, not ~3h. Recovering that partly: P0 is computed ONCE PER SEED rather than per cell. 798a's _train_p0_and_probe takes NO arm parameter (its env is _make_probe_env(seed, **STABLE_DRIFT)), so per-cell recomputation yields a bit-identical agent -- this is the same computation performed once, not an approximation, and it makes the four arms exactly seed-matched. Per-cell would be ~20.2h. CONSEQUENCE, declared: cells share a P0 agent, so all are emitted reuse_ineligible and none may be cited as a baseline mint. Restore is a detached state_dict snapshot onto a freshly built agent, NOT copy.deepcopy (torch refuses -- non-leaf tensors after P0; the authoring smoke caught it), with a per-cell torch.equal control.

GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4). Decisive readout: mean e3_prediction_error over a frozen window, per intake arm, on a base trained by 798a's own P0. Checked both landed 798a executions (20260729T125858Z, 20260730T010651Z) -- they ARE the prior measurement and are cited as the comparison corpus rather than re-run, but neither answers whether the result reproduces on TODAY's ree_core, which is the question -- plus v3_exq_701b/701c (P0 convergence, no intake ladder) and v3_exq_845/901 (consumer-ON sleep-quantity runs, a different question). Not recoverable -> run.

DV-SYMMETRY, per arm. All four share one DV: mean e3_prediction_error over a fixed 900-step frozen window -- a genuine per-run measurement, not an argmax/rank statistic (monotone-rescaling class cannot apply) and not a set-aggregate over interchangeable units (permutation class cannot apply). The manipulation is the RATE of action-map re-permutation, which changes the CONTENT the frozen model is wrong about; a mean is not invariant under it. The criteria read an ORDER and a RATIO across arms, and a broadcast constant common to all arms cancels in the spread -- correct here, since a uniform MEL shift is exactly what 'no intake grading' means and must not read as spread.

RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, fable 5.1, one pass): CONTESTED -- 4 findings, all verified against source or the landed manifests before acting, all disposed. F1 FIXED: the spread statistic was (max-min)/max, a 33% STRICTER bar than the registered (HIGH-NONE)/NONE and not pinned to HIGH/NONE; corrected, old value kept as RECORDED_ONLY. F2 FIXED (reporting) and it is the finding that most changes how this run reads: there are TWO landed 798a executions and they DISAGREE AT SEED 42 -- 20260729 on linux-x86_64 has seed 42 non-monotone at spread 0.1345 (P1 on 2/3 seeds), 20260730 on darwin-arm64 has it monotone at 1.9349 (3/3), with seeds 123 and 456 identical across both. CLAUDE.md records torch.multinomial diverging linux-vs-darwin, and E3 selection runs every step here. Both now appear in comparison_corpus with their machine_class. POWER CONSEQUENCE, recorded not engineered away: need = 2 of 3 and the linux execution lands at exactly 2, so ONE seed decides the verdict. Seeds are NOT raised above 798a's three on purpose -- the fraction rule scales (5 seeds would need 4, a HARDER bar) and seeds 798a never ran would weaken the direct comparison. READ A 2/3 PASS AS 'reproduces 798a-linux exactly', NOT as a comfortable green. F3 ACKNOWLEDGED + INSTRUMENTED: episodes end on health depletion as well as the step cap (causal_grid_world.py:3356) and shifted arms die sooner, so part of any MEL gradient is an episode-phase-mix gradient (the reviewer measured Spearman(MEL, shift_count) 0.78 against Spearman(MEL, 1/eplen) 0.58 over 798a's 24 graded cells, and -0.79 for MEL vs eplen WITHIN the zero-shift arm); P1's own matched-PE and reducibility controls belong to the ladder this run is not running, so every cell additionally reports mel_mean_pe_late_in_episode. A GREEN licenses 'the ladder grades MEL', not yet 'the ladder grades INTAKE'. F4 FIXED: the two components were counted on INDEPENDENT seed sets where 798a requires both on the SAME seed.

SUBSTRATE-PATH OVERLAP (2.5c): no OPEN corrupting entry is on the DV path. The DV is e3_prediction_error from update_residue; contextmemory-write-path-addressing-degeneracy names e1_deep.py::ContextMemory.write, which this run neither gates on nor reads. Degrading overlaps noted: SD-MECH303-THRESHOLD-SOURCING and mode-governance-engagement name config.py / agent.py / causal_grid_world.py broadly; neither routes a criterion here.

SCOPE: experiment_purpose diagnostic, evidence_direction non_contributory BY DESIGN. No sleep pass is configured or fired in any arm.

items.title: ARC-029 P1/P3 joint-feasibility env operating-point sweep (diagnostic)
items.note: DIAGNOSTIC, no claim verdict. User decision 2026-09-19T23:52:40Z (real AskUserQuestion via orchestrate-20260919-2125) OPTION C on decision chip chip-20260919-arc029-p1p3-env-operating-point. Deliverable: the region, if any, where ARC-029's P1 (within-run two-mode occupancy, committed runs >= 3) and P3 (harm DV off the measurement floor) are JOINTLY satisfiable with the variance-tracking commit bar CONFIRMED in force -- plus the rv residual dispersion on a real trained agent that arc029_variance_tracking_commit_bar_build_20260918.md sec 6a says is owed. WHY: the pre-registered ARC-029 evidence design (EXP-1394 / V3-EXQ-063b) was REFUSED at Step 4 and NOT queued -- measured on a trained agent, episodes terminate on health_depleted in 4-9 env steps at the lineage env, the 200-select-call commit window never filled, bar_in_force was 0.000 in every cell and occupancy 1.0000 with one run. Evidence REE_assembly c1f576c709; GFLAG-0371; driver ree-v3 9bbe1b0dab carries a DO-NOT-QUEUE banner. EXP-1394 stays status=proposed -- this run does NOT execute it. GOV-REUSE-1 (Step 2.4): decisive readout is occupancy + committed-run-length + harm SNR with bar_in_force confirmed, jointly across an env ladder. The lever landed 2026-09-18 (6bac3753/9862ed61/3bb81276) and NO recorded manifest has ever run it -- checked evidence/experiments for 063b / arc029 feasibility artifacts, none exist; the only prior measurement is this session's unmanifested probe. Not recoverable -> run. RED-TEAM (Step 4.5, Fable; this session runs on Opus): CONTESTED, 6 findings, all verified against source or against the driver's own dry-run manifest, all FIXED, none dismissed -- F1 committed-run histogram was episode-boundary-blind so P1 was insensitive to the manipulated variable (confirmed in-manifest: one run of 14 across 2 episodes; now 7.0 per-episode vs 21.0 flat, both reported); F2 the SNR-only P3 is scale-invariant and so could not stop a soft rung passing P3 at a harm rate where C1's untouched 0.002 bar is a 25% relative effect -- added an absolute conjunct DERIVED as 0.002/0.20, an autocorrelation-corrected SEM (measured lag-1 rho 0.57, which nearly halves the SNR), and a fixed ENV-STEP denominator; F3 the harm DV was the NET signal which carries benefit -- P3 now routes on env.total_harm deltas with net and benefit reported beside it; F4 training was episode-budgeted while _train_all_on_agent breaks on done, so training depth scaled ~5x along the manipulated dimension -- now tick-budgeted (realised spread 1.02) with a precondition bounding it; F5 D4's inference rule was foreclosed by this run's own warm budget -- corrected; F6 q cells share one agent and reset() does not clear residue -- q order counterbalanced by seed. Not re-spawned (CONTESTED, not BLOCKING). DISPOSITION IS RECORDED, NOT APPLIED: no region -> ARC-029 converts to substrate_conditional per its own P1 text; region found -> re-queue the 1066 evidence design there with C1 re-expressed if needed. BOTH are user decisions and this run takes neither. Smoke PASS (rc=0, sentinel written, dry-run manifest relocated, validate_recording --strict complete). ESTIMATE CAVEAT: 330 min is a central estimate from measured per-step cost on ree-cloud-4 (~214 ms/step eval, ~396 ms train); under sibling-session contention it may reach 5-6h, which is above the ~2-3h the option-C framing assumed. 2 seeds retained because the feasibility predicate requires BOTH seeds.
